summary: Navidrome is an open-source self-hosted music library server (Subsonic-API + native REST/Web UI) that scans local music folders into persistent SQLite tables (MediaFile/Album/Artist/Folder/Tag/Genre/Library), tracks per-user play/rating/star annotations, playlists, play queues, shares, radio stations, transcoding profiles, plugins, external scrobbler buffers and artwork, and exposes those via Subsonic (/rest) and native (/api) HTTP endpoints.
